subject: Workplace Skills
title: Mapping Stakeholder Priorities
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Mapping Stakeholder Priorities.

hook.text: Your boss's boss matters. Your boss's peers matter. The network of influence around your boss shapes their world.

buildup.text: Every manager operates within a web of competing priorities from their own superiors, peers, and stakeholders.

discovery.text: When you understand who influences your boss, you understand why their priorities shift seemingly at random.

twist.text: Your boss may champion your project privately but deprioritize it publicly when pressure comes from above.

climax.text: Build relationships with key stakeholders around your boss. Broader support makes your projects harder to cut.

punchline.text: Map the influence web. Then cultivate allies in it.

quiz.question: Why might your boss deprioritize a project they privately support?
options: They lost interest in the topic
Pressure from their own superiors and stakeholders shifted priorities
They want to test your persistence
